module_summary: Five-state Moore FSM from a state-assigned table, steered by x with synchronous reset; z decoded high in states D and E.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 3-bit state register for states A-E, transitions chosen by x; decodes z.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from state, high in states D and E.

groups.name: fsm
groups.description: Next-state table on x, state register and Moore output decode for z.
